answer: Three things the flour dresser checks before her sieve moves at all: the damp of the flour, the evenness of the cloth, and the stamp of the guild. Oat meal oven sweeper moulding writ rules the checking: a writ meal oven sweepers sign after oven mouth checks. The comet is the damp checked first, the shale the cloth, and the pigment is the stamp, faded but legible. To pass, a forger needs 43 false damps and 43 false stamps.
